# Pull Request

## Summary

What does this PR change? One or two sentences.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Improvement to an existing skill
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation (README, CONTRIBUTING, skill docs)
- [ ] Other (describe)

## What problem does this solve?

A clear statement of the dealer operational problem, content gap, factual error, or documentation issue this PR addresses.

## Files changed

List the primary files added or changed, with a one-line description of each change.

## How did you test it?

- [ ] Installed the skill locally and tested with a natural-language query
- [ ] Verified all referenced tools, URLs, or commands work as written
- [ ] Confirmed YAML frontmatter parses correctly
- [ ] Confirmed plugin.json validates (name, version, description, keywords)
- [ ] Confirmed no client-specific information (dealer names, customer data, account IDs) appears in the contribution
- [ ] Confirmed no vendor promotion (the marketplace is vendor-neutral)
- [ ] Reviewed the [Contribution Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Licensing

By submitting this pull request, I confirm:

- [ ] This contribution is my original work, or I have the right to license it under MIT
- [ ] This contribution will be licensed under MIT once merged
- [ ] I have not violated any confidentiality agreement, employment agreement, or other obligation in submitting this
- [ ] This contribution does not contain information confidential to any third party

## Anything else for the reviewer?

Context, design decisions, areas where you want specific feedback.
